challenges.name: The Aura Vault
challenges.idea: the final boss: a chain of every week-8 move (comment, URL, skipped redirect, cookie, method, header, id); each reply hands over the next clue
challenges.description: Brainrot HQ keeps its Aura Vault behind six doors. Each door's reply tells you how to open the next one, if you read the reply the browser does not show you.
hints: Every reply in this mission hands you the next clue, usually somewhere the browser does not draw. Start with the first row's Response tab, then type the address it mentions into the address bar (or Edit and Resend with a new URL).

The entrance answers with a 302. Click that row: its Response tab has the doorman's note and its Headers tab shows the Set-Cookie he gave you. At the vault, every refusal says what to change next: first your cookie, then the method (read the Allow header), then what your browser calls itself (read the Response Headers).

The vault opens for the cookie rank=sigma, the method POST, and the User-Agent the vault's Response Headers name, all in one Edit and Resend. Then open your locker, click the locker row and check its Payload tab: change the id in the URL to the keeper's locker number from the list on your locker door.
